summary: Join our comprehensive Financing Social Protection Systems Training. Equip yourself with essential tools to design and implement effective financing strategies.
lede: Social protection financing training explains how to estimate program costs, assess fiscal space and compare funding choices. It is for practitioners, budget officers, policy analysts, scheme managers and development staff who influence financing decisions. Learners practice weighing revenue sources and spending trade-offs, building phased financing plans, and using financial and performance information to support sustainable, accountable programs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly work on or influence the financing of social protection systems.
audience: Policy analysts and advisors in ministries
Social insurance and social security scheme managers
modules: Introduction to Social Protection and Financing Logic
Costing Social Protection Programs and Reforms
Revenue Sources and Financing Options for Social Protection
Fiscal Space and the National Budget Process
Prioritization and Trade-offs in Social Protection Spending
Building a Financing Strategy for Social Protection Systems
Domestic and External Financing in Practice
Governance, Leakage, and Value for Money in Social Protection
Financing Shocks, Crises, and Adaptive Social Protection
Communicating and Defending Social Protection Financing Choices
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of social protection systems and public finance. Experience in program management or policy analysis is beneficial.
